# NetDryRun

> NetDryRun is an open-source tool (Python, Apache-2.0) that tests network changes in a real containerlab virtual lab before they reach production. It waits for convergence, checks BGP sessions, prefixes, routes and reachability, and returns a pass/fail verdict with evidence. It runs locally, in GitHub Actions, or as an MCP server for AI agents.

Install: `pip install netdryrun` (version 0.1.0). Source: https://github.com/netdryrun/netdryrun

## Docs

- [Overview](https://netdryrun.com/): what it does, a failing example, the GitHub Action
- [Getting started](https://netdryrun.com/getting-started/): requirements, install, the three examples
- [netdryrun.yml reference](https://netdryrun.com/reference/config/): every check type and key, convergence semantics
- [CLI and reports](https://netdryrun.com/reference/cli/): commands, flags, exit codes, JSON/Markdown/JUnit reports
- [GitHub Action](https://netdryrun.com/github-action/): inputs, outputs, security notes
- [AI agents (MCP)](https://netdryrun.com/ai-agents/): MCP server tools and safety model

## Optional

- [When to use what](https://netdryrun.com/when-to-use-what/): Batfish, netlab, pyATS/Genie, containerlab and NetDryRun compared
- [Trust and security](https://netdryrun.com/trust/): license, releases, security contact, limits, privacy
- [Verdict corpus](https://netdryrun.com/corpus/): benchmark of realistic changes (results pending)
